content.text:
I added `GET /api/me/export` in `src/app/api/me/export/route.ts`. It returns the signed-in patient's own profile (including MRN), appointments, every message they sent or received (with `direction`), and clinical notes. Non-patients get 403.

Psychotherapy notes can't leak into the export. A new `listClinicalForPatient` in `src/repos/notes.ts` reads only `clinical_notes`, and the existing combined `listForPatient` isn't used. A new `listForUser` in `src/repos/messages.ts` supplies the messages. Each export also writes an audit entry that stores ids only.

I added `tests/export.test.ts`. `npm run verify` passes (typecheck plus 20 tests).
